text: At start (tick ~140) the aim hint 'Grimy. Scrub it (2).' under 'Log wall' is drawn on top of the help/controls text and is unreadable; also the clock's 'am' is clipped at the right edge.

Survey: the 'Hole in the roof' item only ticks when the crosshair is exactly on the hole; with the hole clearly visible on screen just below the crosshair (h4) aim still read 'Ceiling boards'. Took several minutes of nudging to find. The hole is small and not hinted on the checklist line.

E taps are dropped at the low frame rate (~7 fps): 'pt key e' three times on an in-reach Broken board did nothing (no sound/message); holding E for 0.4 s picked it up. Key presses shorter than one frame seem to be lost (press-edge polled per frame?).

Fallen shingles lying on top of the snow drift take the crosshair, so holding the shovel on the drift stops working mid-shovel (aim flips to 'Fallen shingle'). The 'Shovel out the snow' checklist line has no percentage, unlike Sweep/Scrub, so there is no overall snow progress shown; state snow went 1.0 -> 0.59 invisibly.

Sawing the Fallen rafter raises the 'Haul out the debris' count from 5 left to 7 left with no message explaining it split into pieces; the pieces are named inconsistently ('Length of rafter' at the crosshair vs 'Piece of rafter'). Also the first 3 s saw hold right after pressing 4 showed 0% (meter stayed at 0).

The last bit of snow (state snow 0.08) is a small drift that sits behind the top-left checklist text from many angles; with no snow percentage on the checklist and no 'snow left' hint, it took a full look-around to find what was still blocking 'Shovel out the snow'.

Outside the cabin, aiming at the exterior 'Log wall' with the scrub brush shows 'Clean here. Move on.' (tick ~49600), the same message as a scrubbed interior wall, while 'Scrub the walls' stays at 31%. Nothing on screen says only the inside counts. Also 'pt walkto hearth' from outside the east wall gets stuck against the wall.
